verified_facts: Located in Periyanaickenpalayam, Coimbatore, 500 meters from the Ooty-Coimbatore National Highway, adjacent to KR Public School (Vishnu Vista project)., 3.1 Cents plot with 1850 sqft built-up area, DTCP approved., Features 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms (3 attached, 1 outer), spacious living hall, kitchen with modular cabinets, and double car parking space.

content_plan.style: Relaxed, local property presenter speaking directly to camera with high retention flow
content_plan.hook_strategy: Highlight the prime location 500m off Ooty Highway in Periyanaickenpalayam alongside 3 BHK Independent House offering

scenes.name: location
scenes.voice: கோவை - ஊட்டி National Highway-ல இருந்து வெறும் 500 meters-ல, Periyanaickenpalayam location-ல KR Public School பக்கத்துல ஒரு 3 BHK Independent House பாக்கலாம்!

scenes.name: price
scenes.voice: 1850 sqft built-up area இருக்குற இந்த வீட்டோட price பாத்தீங்கனா ₹47 Lakhs.

scenes.name: builtUp
scenes.voice: இதுல 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, modular kitchen cabinets, TV unit panel-னு semi-furnished interior வசதிகள் எல்லாமே இருக்கு.

scenes.name: land
scenes.voice: 3.1 Cents land-ல 2 car parking space, individual borewell மற்றும் utility area-வும் அமைச்சிருக்காங்க.

scenes.name: facing
scenes.voice: Main door East facing-ல வரக்கூடிய South-West corner site இது.

scenes.name: approval
scenes.voice: இதுல முக்கியமான விஷயம், இது DTCP approved property.

scenes.name: cta
scenes.voice: நேரடியா site visit பண்ணவோ, more details தெரிஞ்சுக்கவோ உடனே call பண்ணுங்க!

disclosure: Representative locality/property visuals; verify the actual property before purchase.
